recent.text: On November 17, 2025, the @LAKings signed Adrian Kempe to an eight-year, $85 million contract extension. In 11 seasons with the #LAKings, Kempe has 236 goals, 251 assists, and 487 points in 728 games. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/7bUoNEjXVr

recent.text: On November 17, 2014, @LAKings legend Rob Blake was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame. Blake is the second highest scoring defenseman in #LAKings' history with 494 points in 805 games, and was the first defenseman in franchise history to win the Norris Trophy. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/jZFtsmftEK
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 17, 2013, Ben Scrivens became the 10th goaltender in @LAKings' history to record back-to-back shutouts when he shut out the Rangers at Madison Square Garden. Scrivens made 37 saves, and Tyler Toffoli scored the game-winner in a 1-0 win for the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/17by6sCX6J
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 17, 1983, the @LAKings acquired defenseman Mike McEwen from the New York Islanders for a fourth round draft pick. McEwen, who won three Stanley Cup championship rings with the Islanders, scored 10 goals and 34 points in 47 games with the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/EjJHZytFri
